sentences: Lamins are associated with nuclear membrane structure maintenance, as evidenced by the role of lamin A in the nuclear structural defects observed in Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome [34747208].
Additionally, lamin B1 is involved in maintaining chromatin condensation and genome integrity, which are essential for proper nuclear structure [25036988].
The interaction of LC3 with lamin B1 further highlights the importance of lamins in nuclear lamina organization [4452659].
These findings collectively support the role of lamins in nuclear membrane structure maintenance.

Lamins are associated with nuclear membrane structure maintenance, as evidenced by the role of lamin A in the nuclear structural defects observed in Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome [34747208].
Additionally, lamin B1 interacts with the autophagy protein LC3/Atg8, which is involved in maintaining nuclear lamina components [4452659].
The loss of lamin B1 leads to changes in nuclear structure, including decondensation of chromosome territories and increased nuclear blebs [25036988].
These findings support the involvement of lamins in the maintenance of nuclear membrane structure.

Sympathetic nerve activity is increased during normal pregnancy, as shown by higher muscle sympathetic nerve activity (MSNA) in pregnant women compared to nonpregnant controls [5323845].
Additionally, studies have found increased sympathetic activation during early pregnancy and in the third trimester of normotensive pregnancy [26710772, 13907928].
These findings indicate that sympathetic nerve activity is not reduced but rather elevated throughout normal pregnancy.

Cellular differentiation of embryonic stem cells is accompanied by changes in replication timing, as shown by the consolidation of smaller replication domains into larger units during differentiation [8148122].
Changes in replication timing are also coordinated with transcription changes, particularly for weak promoters [8148122].
Additionally, replication-timing changes are accompanied by rearrangements in subnuclear position [8148122].
These findings support the claim that differentiation involves changes in replication timing, transcription, and nuclear localization.

The claim that diminished ovarian reserve is a reliable indicator of infertility in a non-infertile population is not supported by the evidence presented in the abstracts.
The study [13497630] found that biomarkers indicating diminished ovarian reserve were not associated with reduced fertility among women aged 30 to 44 years without a history of infertility.
Therefore, the findings do not support the use of these biomarkers to assess natural fertility in this population.

Diabetes remission occurs more in people treated with laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding surgery than in people treated with conventional therapy.
In a randomized controlled trial, remission of type 2 diabetes was achieved by 73% in the surgical group and 13% in the conventional-therapy group [7098463].

Immune responses in immune cells can be geographically segregated, as evidenced by the formation of localized cytokine niches with sharp boundaries, which contribute to cell-to-cell variability [4928282].
Additionally, tissue-resident memory T cells are specialized for regional immunity, indicating a degree of geographic segregation in immune responses [3155731].
These findings support the idea that immune responses are not uniformly distributed but are instead localized to specific areas.
